# Ringleader

> Ringleader is a missed-call text-back service for trades businesses in Ontario, Canada: plumbers, HVAC, roofers and electricians. When a shop can't pick up, Ringleader texts the caller back within seconds in the shop's name, collects the job details by text, and sends the owner a summary.

- Price: $99 CAD a month, no contract. Or $950 CAD billed yearly.
- Founding deal: the first 20 shops that sign up on the monthly plan by January 31, 2027 pay $69 a month for their first 3 months, then $99.
- Work Line (a separate business number): planned for later. It is not for sale yet and not part of any bill.
- Try it: the home page has a demo where you text as the customer and see what the owner gets.
- Contact: papaadrian.0920@gmail.com, 437-232-2281
